name: Dean Tarulli
bottom_line: A flood-resilience professional's résumé. The Westchester role checks out. His flood-insurance savings figure quotes only the top of FEMA's discount scale.
findings: Westchester hired him as Director of Flood Mitigation and Resiliency.
FEMA's Community Rating System discounts run from 5% to 45%; 35–45% applies only to the top three of nine classes.
page_issues: Roles and the $500 million figure are undated and unsourced.
